title: Nintendo beats earnings thanks to US tariff refunds it won’t share with gamers
summary: Sales for the Switch 2 console itself fell from 5.82 million units to 3.82 million units over the same period, though that current figure is higher than the 2.49 million units Nintendo sold last quarter.
